thinking:
**Revising Visual Styles**

I'm currently focused on `index.css` and need to make some visual style adjustments. My plan is to revert the body, container, cards, and header colors to a dark mode scheme. I also intend to add 3D perspective styling to the cards for an improved visual experience.


**Designing 3D Card Styles**

I'm now implementing the 3D scroll-tilt card styles within the CSS. I'm focusing on the `journey-ribbon-container`, `milestone-row`, and `milestone-year-capsule` elements. The even and odd row positioning is critical; I'm making sure to handle the capsule and card placement correctly on both sides of the timeline, and the transitions. I'm also considering reverting or cleaning up the stats overrides to mesh with the new design.


**Refining Media Queries**

I've just added a media query to ensure the 3D card tilt only applies on desktop screens. It's much cleaner on mobile to keep things flat and readable, so I've added a media query for desktop, `@media (min-width: 1024px)`. I've also checked the Year Capsules in dark mode; they look quite good.


**Checking Dark Mode Styling**

I'm now implementing dark mode styling for the Story Card panels, ensuring they look good and are legible with appropriate color contrasts. I've adjusted the background, border, and box-shadow to fit the dark theme, while also adding styles for when they're active. I've also set the text color to white for the headings and slate-300 for the paragraphs.
